class.name: StructLayout
class.brief_description: The field declaration shared by every [Struct] value of one type.
class.description: A layout lists the fields of a [Struct] type in order: each has a name, a [enum Variant.Type] and a default value. Struct values keep a reference to their layout, so a layout stays alive as long as any value uses it. Layouts are created by the engine for its own result types and by GDScript for [code]struct[/code] declarations, and they are looked up by name when a struct is loaded from a file. Scripts can inspect a layout through this class but cannot create or modify one.

method.name: find_field
method.description: Returns the index of the field called [param name], or [code]-1[/code] if there is no such field.

method.name: find_method
method.description: Returns the index of the method called [param name], or [code]-1[/code] if the struct declares no such method. Operator overloads are methods too, under their reserved names such as [code]_add[/code].

method.name: get_field_count
method.description: Returns the number of fields in the layout.

method.name: get_field_default_value
method.description: Returns the value the field at [param index] starts with when a struct is constructed without an argument for it.

method.name: get_field_name
method.description: Returns the name of the field at [param index].

method.name: get_field_type
method.description: Returns the type of the field at [param index]. A field declared as [Variant] returns [constant TYPE_NIL].

method.name: get_method_count
method.description: Returns the number of methods the struct declares, including operator overloads. Engine structs currently have none.

method.name: get_method_name
method.description: Returns the name of the method at [param index], in declaration order.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Returns the name of the struct type, such as [code]PhysicsRayResult3D[/code] or the name given in a GDScript [code]struct[/code] declaration.

method.name: has_field
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the layout has a field called [param name].
